proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord + magic_item mechanics family
proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord has no 'magic_item' kind. The tracer's exhaustive switch covers only 'spell', 'class_feature', and 'mastery'. A new top-level record type and at least one mechanics family (e.g. 'activated_item' or 'persistent_item') are required before any magic item can be encoded.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Wondrous Item, Very Rare (Requires Attunement) — this is a magic item, not a spell, class feature, or mastery.

proposed_widenings.name: RollKind: 'ability_check'
proposed_widenings.justification: The candle grants Advantage on D20 Tests, which in SRD 5.2.1 means attack rolls, saving throws, AND ability checks. The current RollKind union is 'attack_roll' | 'saving_throw' — it cannot represent the full D20 Test scope.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While you are within that light, you have Advantage on D20 Tests.

proposed_widenings.name: Resource: burn_time (consumable duration resource)
proposed_widenings.justification: The candle tracks remaining burn time (4 hours total, deducted in 1-minute increments when lit). Neither 'use_count' nor 'charge' models a continuous-time consumable that can be snuffed and resumed. A 'burn_time' resource variant is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: After burning for 4 hours, the candle is destroyed. You can snuff it out early for use at a later time. Deduct the time it burned in increments of 1 minute from its total burn time.

proposed_widenings.name: waive_spell_slot_cost (effect atom)
proposed_widenings.justification: The candle allows Clerics and Druids within its light to cast prepared level 1 spells without expending spell slots. This is not 'grant_spell_access' (they already have the spells); it is a conditional resource-waiver. No existing effect atom covers this.
proposed_widenings.evidence: a Cleric or Druid in the light can cast level 1 spells they have prepared without expending spell slots.

proposed_widenings.name: DM-agenda: Gate to GM-chosen Outer Plane
proposed_widenings.justification: The alternative Gate mode links to a plane 'chosen by the GM or determined by rolling on a table'. The destination is DM-adjudicated, placing this outside deterministic core mechanics. If encoded at all it would require a dm_agenda signal.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The portal created by the spell links to a particular Outer Plane chosen by the GM or determined by rolling on the following table.

notes: Primary blocker is structural: 'magic_item' is not in UnitRecord and the tracer has no handler for it. Even if a MagicItemRecord type were added, three additional gaps remain: (1) RollKind needs 'ability_check' for D20 Test coverage, (2) a continuous burn-time consumable resource has no surface representation, (3) waiving spell-slot cost for a class-restricted subset needs a new effect atom. The Gate alternative use is DM-agenda. No .dhall or .json content files authored.
